_comment: Hand-written copy and grouping for the projects page. fetch_projects.py merges this with live GitHub and Copr data into data/projects.json. Edit this file, not projects.json.

projects.title: LGL System Loadout
projects.blurb: A curated Fedora setup wizard for gaming, content creation and development. Pick your loadout, hit install, and let it build the system for you.

projects.title: LGL Papercutter
projects.blurb: A graphical wallpaper editor for Linux. Resize, position, zoom and crop images to fit any display, including portrait and multi-monitor layouts.

projects.title: LGL Scheduler Manager
projects.blurb: Manage sched-ext BPF CPU schedulers from a desktop window instead of the terminal, with scxctl handling the heavy lifting underneath.

projects.title: LGL Colour Picker
projects.blurb: Sample any colour on screen and copy it in ready-to-paste formats. A small utility that stays out of the way until you need it.

projects.title: LGL Emoji Picker
projects.blurb: Search, browse recent history and copy emoji with native styling and clipboard support, on Wayland or X11.

projects.title: LGL DNF Helper
projects.blurb: Inspect installed RPM packages, dependency relationships, related configs, repo origin and package history without wrestling with DNF5 output.

projects.title: LGL Keychron Helper
projects.blurb: Configure supported Keychron keyboards and update firmware on Linux, without opening a separate Chromium browser just for the web launcher.

projects.title: LGL Power Profile Manager
projects.blurb: A simple desktop front end for switching between tuned power profiles, so battery, balanced and performance modes are one click apart.

projects.title: LGL cliamp
projects.blurb: A Fedora-tested build of cliamp, the terminal music player inspired by Winamp, with a minimal visualiser and a mirrored classic peak view.

projects.title: LGL VM Curator
projects.blurb: Packaging for vm-curator, a fast TUI that builds and manages QEMU/KVM virtual machines with working 3D acceleration.

projects.title: Fedora niri + Noctalia
projects.blurb: Turn a Fedora minimal install into a lightweight Wayland desktop built on niri and Noctalia, straight from the TTY.

projects.title: Arch niri + Noctalia
projects.blurb: The same niri and Noctalia desktop on Arch, starting from a base install or an existing desktop environment.

projects.title: Fedora Bootstrap: KDE
projects.blurb: Builds a complete KDE Plasma desktop from Fedora Everything Minimal, with gaming, multimedia, virtualisation and creator tooling in one script.

projects.title: Fedora Bootstrap: Cinnamon
projects.blurb: Converts a fresh Fedora Everything Minimal install into the full Linux Gamer Life Cinnamon environment.

projects.title: Fedora Bootstrap: CachyOS
projects.blurb: A Fedora bootstrap with KDE Plasma, the CachyOS kernel and the tools used day to day for gaming and creating.

projects.title: Arch Bootstrap: KDE
projects.blurb: Installs the Linux Gamer Life KDE Plasma environment on a fresh Arch install, designed to run once from the TTY after archinstall.

projects.title: openSUSE Bootstrap: KDE
projects.blurb: The openSUSE take on the bootstrap scripts: a minimal starting point turned into a KDE Plasma desktop with the usual LGL tooling.

projects.title: Debian Installer Experiment
projects.blurb: An experiment in getting close to the Arch experience on Debian. Proof of concept, intelligently prompted but unapologetically vibecoded.

projects.title: LGLWM
projects.blurb: An attempt at a custom Wayland session for Fedora. Part learning exercise, part excuse to understand how a desktop actually fits together.

projects.title: Browser Theming
projects.blurb: A local start page that keeps Chromium-based browsers in step with Noctalia's current colour palette, so every new tab matches the desktop.

projects.title: Wallpapers
projects.blurb: A collection of wallpapers used on the channel and in the Linux Gamer Life setups, plus the tooling that prepares them.

projects.title: LGL Icons
projects.blurb: Custom icons drawn for the desktop and the channel, from application shortcuts to stream and overlay artwork.

projects.title: LGL Wallcards
projects.blurb: A port of the v4 wallcards plugin to v5, keeping the wallpaper-driven card workflow alive on current versions.

projects.title: LGL Docs
projects.blurb: Documentation and standards shared across the projects in these repositories, so the tools behave the same way.

projects.title: Random Stuff
projects.blurb: A home for the one-off scripts and workflow helpers that solve a specific problem once and then earn their keep.
